info.description: SwiftRead turns articles and web pages into natural spoken audio. POST a page URL to /read-url and it fetches the page, extracts the article's main text (navigation and boilerplate stripped), and reads it aloud in a natural neural voice, returning audio/mpeg directly - the listen-to-this-article button as an API. POST raw text to /speak to hear your own content. The full neural voice catalog is listed at GET /voices: 322 voices across 75 languages and 142 locales (filter with ?language=, ?locale=, ?gender=), ordered most-spoken languages first, with a featured set of curated picks - English (US, UK, Kenyan, Nigerian, Tanzanian, South African), Mandarin Chinese, Hindi, Spanish, French, Arabic, Portuguese, Russian, Japanese, German, Swahili, Amharic, Somali, Zulu, Afrikaans, and more. Paragraph breaks are read as natural pauses, chunks are synthesized in parallel so long articles return fast, an optional rate slows or speeds the reading, and plans bill per request, never per character. Every request is capped at 15,000 characters of text (roughly 15 minutes of speech; long articles can take a while to synthesize, so treat these as slow endpoints). Every failure is a structured JSON error that names the problem - over-cap text, no article text found on the page, an unknown voice - never a bare 503.

200.description: Service health, engine, limits, and endpoint list

rate.description: Optional speaking rate: a multiplier between 0.5 and 2.0, or a percent string like '-15%'. Clamped to -50%..+100%.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the article page to read aloud

200.description: The article read aloud as MP3 audio. Response headers report the voice, character count, chunk count, paragraph count, and the article title.

422.description: Structured JSON error: missing/invalid parameter, page refused (non-public address), no article text found, or extracted text over the 15,000-character cap (the error names the cap and the length received)

502.description: Structured JSON error: the source page failed or synthesis failed

post.summary: Read an article page aloud: URL in, MP3 audio out
